1) ELSE country.phone_prefix END, '[^0-9]', '') AS phonePrefix, country.iso2 AS countryIso2, 1 AS sourcePriority FROM country WHERE country.deleted_at IS NULL AND country.is_enabled = 1 UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT( REGEXP_REPLACE( SUBSTRING(country.phone_prefix, 1, LOCATE('-', country.phone_prefix) - 1), '[^0-9]', ''), REGEXP_REPLACE( CASE WHEN LOCATE('/', SUBSTRING(country.phone_prefix, LOCATE('/', country.phone_prefix) + 1)) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING( SUBSTRING(country.phone_prefix, LOCATE('/', country.phone_prefix) + 1), 1, LOCATE('/', SUBSTRING(country.phone_prefix, LOCATE('/', country.phone_prefix) + 1)) - 1) ELSE SUBSTRING(country.phone_prefix, LOCATE('/', country.phone_prefix) + 1) END, '[^0-9]', '') ) AS phonePrefix, country.iso2 AS countryIso2, 1 AS sourcePriority FROM country WHERE country.deleted_at IS NULL AND country.is_enabled = 1 AND country.phone_prefix LIKE '%/%' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT( REGEXP_REPLACE( SUBSTRING(country.phone_prefix, 1, LOCATE('-', country.phone_prefix) - 1), '[^0-9]', ''), REGEXP_REPLACE( SUBSTRING( SUBSTRING(country.phone_prefix, LOCATE('/', country.phone_prefix) + 1), LOCATE('/', SUBSTRING(country.phone_prefix, LOCATE('/', country.phone_prefix) + 1)) + 1), '[^0-9]', '') ) AS phonePrefix, country.iso2 AS countryIso2, 1 AS sourcePriority FROM country WHERE country.deleted_at IS NULL AND country.is_enabled = 1 AND country.phone_prefix LIKE '%/%/%' ) prefix WHERE REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(a.ws_phone), '+', ''), ' ', '') LIKE CONCAT(prefix.phonePrefix, '%') ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(prefix.phonePrefix) DESC, prefix.sourcePriority ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS countryIso2 FROM account a INNER JOIN account_state s ON s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND s.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN account_credential c ON c.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND c.account_id = a.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN account_profile p ON p.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND p.account_id = a.id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR c.tenant_id IS NULL) AND (p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR p.tenant_id IS NULL) AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.account_state = 2 AND (s.mute_status IS NULL OR s.mute_status = 2) AND a.ws_phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.ws_phone) <> '' AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_account_id) <> '' AND a.protocol_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_id) <> '' ) candidate
